gist.headline: The manual caught up
gist.blurb: The API reference got a small post-deploy refresh. Even documentation needs to check what actually shipped.
gist.summary: Regenerated APIDOCS.md from the OpenAPI spec after a successful production deploy, replacing seven lines to keep the published reference in sync.
gist.impact: Developers reading APIDOCS.md now have a reference aligned with the deployed OpenAPI spec.
